dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。相談にお越し下さりありがとうございます。最初に、性別と年代、なんとお呼びしたら良いか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your gender, age range, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: はい、宜しくお願い致します。27才の女性で、れなです。宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. I'm Rena, a 27-year-old woman. Pleased to meet you.

dialogue.origin: れなさんですね。よろしくお願いいたします。今日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Rena, is that right? It's a pleasure to meet you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: はい、3年前に同じ企業に勤める若手社員と恋愛結婚しました。
dialogue.content: Yes, three years ago, I had a love marriage with a junior employee from the same company.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そしてどうされましたか？
dialogue.content: And then what happened?

dialogue.origin: 結婚後1年目に妊娠し、会社を辞めました
dialogue.content: I got pregnant in the first year of our marriage and quit my job.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: その後育に追われるが、おっは仕事が忙しくて深夜帰宅が多く、週末も出勤する。
dialogue.content: After that, I became overwhelmed with childcare, while my husband is so swamped with work that he often comes home late at night and even works on weekends.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: （携帯なので、少し長めにお待ちした方が良いのですよね？）
dialogue.content: (Since you're on your mobile phone, I should probably wait a little longer, right?)

dialogue.origin: 最近、夫婦の会話も、少なくなってうつ気味になりカウンセラーをお願いしました。
dialogue.content: Lately, my husband and I haven't been talking much, and I've been feeling a bit depressed, so I decided to seek counseling.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。育児もなれないのに、旦那さんには手伝ってもらえず、、それはとても疲れてしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. You're not yet used to childcare, and your husband isn't helping out... that must be very exhausting for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: 会話も少ないと気分転換も出来ない感じですよね。うつ気味というのは、どういったことを感じられていますか？
dialogue.content: With so little conversation, it must feel like you can't even get a change of pace. When you say you feel depressed, what kinds of things are you experiencing?

dialogue.origin: 育児も初めてで、不安な上主人の帰りも遅く楽しみより、不安な毎日が続く感じです
dialogue.content: It's my first time raising a child, so I'm anxious, and on top of that, my husband comes home late. It feels like every day is filled with more anxiety than joy.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そうですよね。。初めての育児ですものね。。ご主人とも色々相談したいですよね。。近くに育児についてお話できる友人やご家族はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: I understand, that makes sense. It's your first time with childcare, after all. You must want to discuss various things with your husband. Do you have any friends or family nearby you can talk to about childcare?

dialogue.origin: マンションなので、周りに友達も居なくそとにでるのが、おっくうになっています
dialogue.content: Since we live in an apartment, I don't have any friends around, and going outside has become a hassle.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。なかなか気晴らしが出来ない環境なのですね？
dialogue.content: I see. So you're in an environment where it's difficult to get a break?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それはつらいですね。。お子さんが生まれてから、ずっとそういった状況なのですか？
dialogue.content: That must be tough. Has it been like this ever since your child was born?

dialogue.origin: はい、若い人も余り見かけないので、部屋の中が多いです
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't see many young people around, so I spend most of my time indoors.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。若い方が少ない地域にお住まいなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you live in an area with few young people.

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんはお仕事が忙しいとのことですが、お子さんが生まれてから、お子さんとはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your husband is busy with work, but how has he been with the child since they were born?

dialogue.origin: 若い方は昼お仕事に出かけているのかな？
dialogue.content: I guess the young people around here are out working during the day.

dialogue.origin: なるほどです。
dialogue.content: That could be.

dialogue.origin: 産まれた時は、早く仕事から帰って来てくれたのですか、最近は休みもないほど、忙しい状態です
dialogue.content: When the baby was born, he used to come home from work early, but lately, he's so busy he doesn't even have days off.

dialogue.origin: そんなに忙しいのですね。。では、なかなか色々と相談できる時間もとれなさそうですね。
dialogue.content: He's that busy... It sounds like it's difficult to find time to discuss various things with him.

dialogue.origin: ゆっくり、離す時間もない感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like we don't have time to just sit and talk calmly.

dialogue.origin: 話すです
dialogue.content: I mean, 'talk'.

dialogue.origin: （はい。）そっか、色々と楽しいことを話したり、悩んでいることを一番に効いてほしいですよね？
dialogue.content: (Yes.) I see. You want him to be the first person you can talk with about fun things and, most importantly, the one who listens to your worries, right?

dialogue.origin: （効いて→聞いて　です。）
dialogue.content: (I meant "listen," not "be effective.")

dialogue.origin: はい、それが出来れば、少しは楽になるのですが
dialogue.content: Yes, if we could do that, I think I'd feel a bit better.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。1人育児は大変だと思います。とても頑張っておられますね。れなさんは、今のご主人に対してどう思っておられますか？
dialogue.content: I know what you mean. Raising a child by yourself must be very difficult. You're trying so hard. Rena, how do you feel about your husband at the moment?

dialogue.origin: 家族のために、休むひまもなく一生懸命働いてくれているのは、分かるのですが
dialogue.content: I understand that he's working tirelessly for the family without a moment's rest, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: もう少しお話をする時間をとってもらいたい、という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you feel like you'd like him to make a bit more time to talk?

dialogue.origin: 休みの日まで、出勤と言って家を出て行きますが？本当に仕事？と変な気持ちが出てきて、考え過ぎのときもありますので、、よけいに不安になってしまいます
dialogue.content: He even leaves the house on his days off, saying he has to go to work. But I get this strange feeling, like, "Is he really working?" Sometimes I overthink it, and that just makes me even more anxious.

dialogue.origin: なるほどです。。お休みが無いくらいに忙しいので、休みの日に本当に仕事なの？という、疑う気持ちが出てきてしまってるのですね。。お話をする時間も減っているので、余計に不安になってしまいますね。
dialogue.content: I see. He's so busy that he hardly has any days off, so on those days, you find yourself wondering if he's really going to work. And since you have less time to talk, it's only natural that you'd feel more anxious.

dialogue.origin: 考え過ぎなのは分かっているのですが
dialogue.content: I know I'm overthinking it, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。お家にお子さんと2人でいることが多い事もあって、考え始めると、考えすぎてしまうのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. Since you’re often at home alone with your child, it may be that once you start thinking about it, it's easy to spiral into overthinking.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: ご主人さんに、1人で育児をしているし、たまにしんどくなって色々考えすぎてしまう、とお話ししてみたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever tried telling your husband that you're raising your child alone, and that sometimes it gets overwhelming and you end up overthinking things?

dialogue.origin: たまにありますが、主人もどうしてよいかわからないと、仕事と私の間に挟まれて、主人も辛くなると思います、いまは余り話はしないです
dialogue.content: I have, occasionally, but he doesn't know what to do, and I think he would feel caught between work and me, which would be hard on him. So I don't really talk about it much now.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そうなんですね。ご主人を思って、相談もできない感じになっているのですね。。切ないですね。。ご主人さんは仕事が忙しいとのことですが、ご様子はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it is. You're trying to be considerate of your husband, so it feels like you can't even talk to him about it... That's heartbreaking. You mentioned he's busy with work, but how does he seem to be doing?

dialogue.origin: 休みたいけど、休めない感じですかね。身体を壊さなければ良いのですが、
dialogue.content: It seems like he wants to rest but can't. I just hope he doesn't work himself into poor health.

dialogue.origin: 少しの間、実家に帰って私も休みたいなと思う時があります。
dialogue.content: Sometimes I think I'd like to go back to my parents' house for a little while and get some rest myself.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。それは、旦那さんの身体の方も心配になってしまいますね。。それは、良い案のように思うのですが、難しいのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you worry about your husband's health as well. That sounds like a good idea, but is it difficult for you to do?

dialogue.origin: それは、は実家に帰るという案です。
dialogue.content: By "that," I mean the idea of going back to your parents' house.

dialogue.origin: 車で、1時間位です。
dialogue.content: It's about an hour's drive.

dialogue.origin: そしたら、ご実家に帰られたらいかがでしょうか？れなさんの親御さんも喜ばれるのではないですか？
dialogue.content: In that case, why not go to your parents' home for a little while? I imagine your parents would be happy to see you and their grandchild.

dialogue.origin: たまには、孫の顔を見せないと
dialogue.content: I should probably let them see their grandchild every once in a while.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: でも、今コロナの為、実家にいくのも難しいかな、もし、年寄りにうつしたらたいへんですね
dialogue.content: But with COVID right now, it might be difficult to go to their place. It would be terrible if I gave it to them, since they're elderly.

dialogue.origin: また、考え過ぎでしょうか
dialogue.content: Am I overthinking it again?

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。気になってしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It's understandable to be concerned about that.

dialogue.origin: なので、近くに住まれているけれど、お子さんを見てもらったり、というのが難しく感じておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: So even though they live nearby, you feel it's difficult to ask them to look after your child.

dialogue.origin: 最近は、こんな感じで、いつも、考え過ぎてしまいます。
dialogue.content: Lately, it's always like this; I end up overthinking everything.

dialogue.origin: 色々疲れたりされているからかもしれませんね。1人で頑張って育児をされていますし、れなさんも少しご自分の身体を休められる機会があると良いなと思うのです。ベビーシッターさんや一時預かり等はできなさそうですか？　やはりコロナが気になってしまいますか？
dialogue.content: It might be because you're exhausted from everything. You're working so hard raising your child on your own, so I think it would be good if you had a chance to rest your own body a little. Would a babysitter or temporary childcare be out of the question? Or are you still hesitant because of COVID?

dialogue.origin: 探しているのですか、コロナで、なかなか見つかりません
dialogue.content: I've been looking, but with COVID, it's been hard to find anyone.

dialogue.origin: なるほどです。これまでにも探しておられるのですね。見つからないと、そんなことからも焦ってしまいますよね。ちなみに、れなさんの親御さんはこれらの事についてどう思われているのですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so you have already been looking. When you can't find any help, that itself can make you feel even more anxious. By the way, what do your parents think about all of this?

dialogue.origin: 、両親も、様子をみにきたいと言ってくれていますが、コロナで、余り動けないかんじです。今、気持ちを聞いていただけで、少し分かってもらえて、楽になりました
dialogue.content: My parents have said they want to come and see how I'm doing, but they can't really travel much because of COVID. Just having you listen to how I feel has made me feel understood, and I'm a little relieved.

dialogue.origin: 少し頑張れそうです、
dialogue.content: I feel like I can keep going for a little while longer.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、それは少しでもお気持ちが楽になっていただけて良かったです。ごめんなさい、そろそろ相談のお時間が来てしまいました。お話ししたいことはお話ししていただけましたか？
dialogue.content: Is that so? I'm glad to hear that you're feeling even a little lighter. I'm sorry, but our consultation time is almost up. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to?

dialogue.origin: また、悩んだら！話を聞いて下さい。今日はありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.content: If I'm struggling again, please listen to me. Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: はい、それは良かったです！お1人で育児をされていますし、疲れてしまうこともあると思います。自分を休められる機会が見つかるといいですね。本当に頑張っておられると思いますよ！もしコロナの検査等を受けて不安を減らして、誰かに見てもらえるようになるといいなとも思っています。そんなことも考えてみて下さいね。それでは、今日はどうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's wonderful! You're raising your child by yourself, so I'm sure there are times you get exhausted. I hope you can find an opportunity to give yourself a rest. I truly think you're doing a great job. I also hope that you might be able to, for instance, get a COVID test to reduce your anxiety and then have someone watch your child. Please consider that as an option. Well then, thank you very much for your time today.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.content: I understand. Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 夫とのコミュニケーション不足
